      # Check for chained `dig` calls that can be collapsed into a single `dig`.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it cannot be guaranteed that the receiver

      #   of `dig`.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)

display.text:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for chained `dig` calls that can be collapsed into a single `dig`.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it cannot be guaranteed that the receiver
      #   is an `Enumerable` or does not have a nonstandard implementation
      #   of `dig`.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      #
      #   # good - `dig`s cannot be combined
      #   x.dig(:foo).bar.dig(:baz)
      #
      class DigChain < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include CommentsHelp
        include DigHelp

        MSG = 'Use `%<replacement>s` instead of chaining.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[dig].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          inspect_chain(node)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        private

        # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
        def inspect_chain(node)
          origin_node = node
          return unless origin_node

          origin_loc = origin_node.loc
          return unless origin_loc

          origin_range = origin_node.source_range
          origin_buffer = origin_range.source_buffer
          chain_end_pos = origin_range.end_pos
          collected_arguments = []
          origin_arguments = origin_node.arguments
          if origin_arguments
            origin_index = 0
            origin_argument_count = origin_arguments.size
            while origin_index < origin_argument_count
              origin_argument = origin_arguments[origin_index]
              collected_arguments << origin_argument
              origin_index += 1
            end
          else
            collected_arguments = []
          end

          chain_begin_pos = nil
          current_node = origin_node
          visited_receivers = 0

          while current_node
            receiver = current_node.receiver
            if receiver
              receiver_is_send = receiver.send_type?
              receiver_is_csend = receiver.csend_type?
              if receiver_is_send
                walkable_receiver = true
              elsif receiver_is_csend
                walkable_receiver = true
              else
                walkable_receiver = false
              end

              if walkable_receiver
                receiver_method = receiver.method_name
                if receiver_method == :dig
                  receiver_arguments = receiver.arguments
                  receiver_argument_count = 0
                  if receiver_arguments
                    receiver_argument_count = receiver_arguments.size
                  end

                  if receiver_argument_count.positive?
                    rejected_argument = false
                    pending_arguments = []
                    argument_index = 0
                    while argument_index < receiver_argument_count
                      argument = receiver_arguments[argument_index]
                      argument_hash = argument.hash_type?
                      argument_block_pass = argument.block_pass_type?
                      rejected_argument ||= argument_hash
                      rejected_argument ||= argument_block_pass
                      pending_arguments << argument
                      argument_index += 1
                    end

                    if rejected_argument
                      current_node = nil
                    elsif dig?(receiver)
                      receiver_loc = receiver.loc
                      dot_location = receiver_loc.dot
                      chain_begin_pos = (dot_location && (dot_location.begin_pos + 1)) || 0
                      collected_arguments.unshift(*pending_arguments)
                      ignore_node(receiver)
                      current_node = receiver
                      visited_receivers += 1
                    else
                      current_node = nil
                    end
                  else
                    current_node = nil
                  end
                else
                  current_node = nil
                end
              else
                current_node = nil
              end
            else
              current_node = nil
            end
          end

          return if visited_receivers.zero?
          return unless chain_begin_pos

          forwarded_args_not_last = false
          combined_count = collected_arguments.size
          if combined_count.positive?
            combined_index = 0
            last_combined_index = combined_count - 1
            while combined_index < combined_count
              combined_argument = collected_arguments[combined_index]
              forwarded_argument = combined_argument.forwarded_args_type?
              forwarded_args_not_last ||= forwarded_argument && combined_index < last_combined_index
              combined_index += 1
            end
          end
          return if forwarded_args_not_last
          return if invalid_arguments?(collected_arguments)

          combined_range = range_between(chain_begin_pos, chain_end_pos)
          return unless combined_range

          combined_range = Parser::Source::Range.new(
            origin_buffer,
            combined_range.begin_pos,
            combined_range.end_pos
          )

          replacement_parts = []
          replacement_index = 0
          remaining_replacements = combined_count
          while remaining_replacements.positive?
            replacement_argument = collected_arguments[replacement_index]
            replacement_source = replacement_argument.source
            replacement_parts << replacement_source
            replacement_index += 1
            remaining_replacements -= 1
          end
          joined_arguments = replacement_parts.join(', ')
          replacement_prefix = 'dig('
          replacement_suffix = ')'
          replacement = "#{replacement_prefix}#{joined_arguments}#{replacement_suffix}"
          offense_message = format(MSG, replacement: replacement)
          disable_overlap = comments_contain_disables?(origin_node, cop_name)
          comment_overlap = contains_comments?(origin_node)

          add_offense(combined_range, message: offense_message) do |corrector|
            corrector.replace(combined_range, replacement)
            if comment_overlap
              comments_in_range(origin_node).reverse_each do |comment|
                comment_text = comment.source
                corrector.insert_before(origin_node, "#{comment_text}\n")
              end
            elsif disable_overlap
              comments_in_range(origin_node).reverse_each do |comment|
                comment_text = comment.source
                corrector.insert_before(origin_node, "#{comment_text}\n")
              end
            end
          end

          [combined_range, collected_arguments]
        end

        def invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          # If any of the arguments are arguments forwarding (`...`), it can only be the
          # first argument, or else the resulting code will have a syntax error.

          return false unless arguments&.any?

          forwarded_args_index = arguments.index(&:forwarded_args_type?)
          forwarded_args_index && forwarded_args_index < (arguments.size - 1)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `lib/rubocop/cop/style/dig_chain.rb:115`: the chain start position was computed as `dot_location.begin_pos + 1`, which only skips one character. For safe navigation the dot operator is `&.` (two characters), so the autocorrect range started one character early, eating the `.` and producing `hoge & dig(:a, :b)`.

Changed it to `dot_location.end_pos`, which correctly handles both `.` and `&.`:

- `hoge&.dig(:a)&.dig(:b)` → `hoge&.dig(:a, :b)` ✓
- `hoge.dig(:a).dig(:b)` → `hoge.dig(:a, :b)` ✓ (unchanged behavior)

Verified with `spec/rubocop/cop/style/dig_chain_spec.rb` (23 examples, 0 failures) and `spec/rubocop/cop/style/single_argument_dig_spec.rb` (15 examples, 0 failures).
